name: Mattermost
description: Mattermost is a secure collaboration platform with an open-source Team Edition and paid Professional, Enterprise, and Enterprise Advanced offerings for organizations that need control over deployment, data, and operational workflows.
best_for: Best suited to technical, operations, government, defense, and regulated teams that need self-hosting or private-cloud options, data sovereignty, workflow automation, and tighter administrative control than general-purpose SaaS chat.
features: Channel-based messaging, file sharing, threaded discussions, and search
Playbooks and workflow automation for repeatable operational processes
REST API, webhooks, slash commands, plugins, and MCP Server integrations
Bring-your-own and multi-LLM support in the agentic platform
Enterprise access controls, compliance, high availability, and secure mobility on higher tiers

alternatives.name: Rocket.Chat
alternatives.description: A secure communications platform with self-hosted, on-premises, and air-gapped deployment options.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations comparing self-hosted collaboration platforms for data sovereignty and controlled infrastructure.

alternatives.name: Slack
alternatives.description: A managed workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, integrations, and searchable conversations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prefer a fully managed SaaS collaboration tool with a large integration ecosystem.

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A managed communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, file sharing, and Microsoft 365 integration.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations already standardized on Microsoft 365 and Microsoft identity tooling.

pricing.starting_price: Team Edition is open source and free; paid Professional and Enterprise packages require a quote

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Paid subscription; numeric public price is not listed. Self-hosted licenses are prepaid annual seat subscriptions.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Paid subscription with broader compliance, workflow, scale, and administration capabilities; contact sales.

tiers.name: Enterprise Advanced
tiers.notes: Quote-based package for multi-domain, resilient, air-gapped, and high-security environments.

cons: Mattermost does not publish stable numeric prices for Professional, Enterprise, or Enterprise Advanced; buyers need a quote.
Paid self-hosted Professional and Enterprise licenses are prepaid annual seat subscriptions, so the commitment is different from month-to-month SaaS chat.
Running Team Edition or another self-hosted deployment means your organization owns infrastructure, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and operational security.

faq.question: Is Mattermost free?
faq.answer: Yes. Mattermost Team Edition is open source under the MIT License and can be self-hosted without a paid subscription. Paid Professional, Enterprise, and Enterprise Advanced offerings add commercial features, support, and administration capabilities.

faq.question: How much do paid Mattermost plans cost?
faq.answer: Mattermost does not publish stable numeric prices for its current paid Professional and Enterprise packages. Buyers need to contact sales for a quote; self-hosted paid licenses are sold as prepaid annual seat subscriptions.

faq.question: Does Mattermost have a free trial?
faq.answer: Mattermost documents a 30-day Enterprise trial for self-hosted deployments. The trial is for evaluation and is separate from the permanently free open-source Team Edition.

faq.question: What should I plan for when moving to or from Mattermost?
faq.answer: Plan for users, channels, message history, files, integrations, identity, retention rules, and deployment infrastructure. Mattermost documents migration tooling for several systems, but large self-hosted migrations should be tested in staging before cutover.
